## How the claims were checked

Every statement about what the VM does needs one of these. Delete the lines that do not apply, and say which claim each one covers.

- [ ] A runnable cell in the lesson, named, that a reader can execute and see the result of.
- [ ] A citation into the pinned tree, written as `path:line@OTP-29.0.5`.
- [ ] A proof or a model check, with the oracle named and the output attached.
- [ ] A documented contract from the OTP documentation, cited.
- [ ] Nothing, because this change makes no claim about the VM.

New claims are in the ledger with an evidence class: <!-- CLM ids, or none -->

## Checks

- [ ] `just check` passes locally.
- [ ] Any new lesson has a prediction gate before the reader runs anything.
- [ ] Any new blueprint stands on its own and does not refer back to the lesson.
- [ ] Numbers that came from the OTP tree are in `drift.toml` if they would make the book wrong when they change.
